changelog: Initial release v1.0.0: Three-phase PDF bilingual translation pipeline (Extract → Translate → Render) powered by BabelDOC + LLM bridge. Features: layout-preserving side-by-side bilingual output, offline CJK font patching, parallel batch translation, built-in verification. Created by Wang Dongjie 王东杰.
display_name: IBCAT - International Bilingual Chinese Advanced Translator
summary: Translate and generate bilingual side-by-side PDFs preserving original layout by extracting, translating, and rendering content with BabelDOC and LLM.
